findings.zero_slack_prize_asymmetry: Prizing a direct restorer reduces current unlock access, while Prizing a remover does not change zero-slack access because remover copies are already mechanically dead.
findings.one_slack_symmetry: With one Bench slack and symmetric access, a direct restorer and remover become equivalent live outs, so one copy of either being Prized has the same access effect.
findings.belief_state: K0 is a distribution over live-out counts; K1 collapses to the realized state-specific count and can materially change the estimated unlock probability.
